title: Conversation Engine and SQL-Driven Personality Contract
summary: KESPA moved normal personality selection and tuning out of phrase-specific Brain patches into an application-side Conversation Engine backed by brain_config. The engine derives per-turn conversational posture and personality dimensions from current context, recent tone, durable communication preferences, and SQL policy, then sends a machine-readable behavior contract to Brain for generic style validation and repair. Live testing demonstrated differentiated casual, celebratory, and supportive behavior; tuning remains ongoing and no formal conversation-regression benchmark is claimed at this checkpoint.

architecture_boundary.conversation_engine: selects posture, dimensions, and behavioral policy from context/preferences/configuration
architecture_boundary.brain: generates, validates style compliance, and performs generic style-only repair when needed
